entries.title: Psalms 147:1
segments: Praise the LORD; for [it is] good to sing praises to our God; for praise [is] delightful [and] becoming.

entries.title: Psalms 147:2
segments: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 147:3
segments: He heals the broken-hearted, and binds up their wounds.

entries.title: Psalms 147:4
segments: He appoints the number of the stars; He calls them all by [their] names.

entries.title: Psalms 147:5
segments: Great [is] our LORD, and of great power; [There is] no limit to His understanding.

entries.title: Psalms 147:6
segments: The LORD lifts up the meek; He throws the wicked down to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 147:7
segments: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise on the harp to our God,

entries.title: Psalms 147:8
segments: who covers the heavens with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow [on] the mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 147:9
segments: He gives the beasts its food, [and] to the young ravens which cry.

entries.title: Psalms 147:10
segments: He delights not in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

entries.title: Psalms 147:11
segments: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear Him, who hope in His mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 147:12
segments: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 147:13
segments: For He has made the bars of your gates strong; He has blessed your sons within you.

entries.title: Psalms 147:14
segments: He makes peace [in] your borders [and] fills you with the finest of the wheat.

entries.title: Psalms 147:15
segments: He sends forth His commandment [on] earth; His word runs very swiftly.

entries.title: Psalms 147:16
segments: He gives snow like wool; He scatters the hoarfrost like ashes.

entries.title: Psalms 147:17
segments: He casts forth His ice like crumbs; who can stand before His cold?

entries.title: Psalms 147:18
segments: He sends out His word and melts them; He causes His wind to blow, [and] the waters flow.

entries.title: Psalms 147:19
segments: He shows His word to Jacob, His statutes and His judgments to Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 147:20
segments: He has not done so with any nation; and they have not known [His] judgments. Praise the LORD!
